Recent GDP data show resilience, driven by strong private consumption and exports. YES Bank projects that the RBI could implement a cumulative 50‑basis‑point rate increase.

snapshots.title: Two killed, eight injured in attack at Dammam’s King Fahd International Airport
snapshots.summary: Two people – a Saudi citizen and an Indian resident – were killed and eight others were injured in an incident at King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, eastern Saudi Arabia, on Wednesday evening. The General Authority of Civil Aviation said it had not identified the type of attack. Earlier that day a drone intercepted over the Eastern Province caused two deaths near an Aramco processing facility.
